name: Rely VP Heavy Duty Furniture Connector Bolts & Cross Dowel Barrel Nuts (M6/M8)
shortDescription: Precision zinc-plated carbon steel flat-head hex socket connector bolts with mating threaded barrel cross dowels for rigid structural joint assembly.
overview: Rely VP Industries connector bolts and cross dowel barrel nuts provide rigid, high-load fastening solutions for modular partition walls, heavy timber structures, architectural fixtures, and commercial composite casework. Cold-forged from Grade 4.8 high-tensile carbon steel and finished with a corrosion-resistant yellow or bright zinc electroplating, the bolts feature a low-profile flat round wafer head with an internal hex socket drive that sits nearly flush against workpiece surfaces. The mating cylindrical barrel nuts feature an off-center threaded cross hole that securely locks perpendicular joints together.
keyFeatures: Cold-forged from Grade 4.8 carbon steel providing high shear and clamping force
Protective zinc electroplating resists corrosion, oxidation, and tarnishing
Wide low-profile wafer head spreads clamping load to prevent surface crushing
Deep internal hexagonal socket drive prevents cam-out during power driver assembly
Cylindrical cross-dowel barrel nut provides high pullout resistance in blind holes
Clean precision rolled metric threads (ISO 6g tolerance) ensure effortless threading
Available in standard metric diameters M6 and M8 in lengths from 40mm to 120mm

specifications.Thread Sizes: M6 x 1.0 mm / M8 x 1.25 mm Metric Pitch
specifications.Plating: Yellow Passivated Zinc / Bright Blue Zinc
specifications.Drive Type: Internal Hexagonal Allen Key (4 mm for M6 / 5 mm for M8)

applications: Commercial acoustic office partition wall installation
Modular industrial timber framing, workstations, and laboratory benches
Heavy knockdown composite furniture and store display fixture assembly

20x Mating Slotted Cross Dowel Barrel Nuts
